crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The sample is a Windows kernel-mode driver that utilizes the Kernel Streaming (KS) framework, typically used for multimedia devices or software-emulated bus objects. The analysis shows a standard driver initialization via GsDriverEntry and DriverEntry, which registers dispatchers for PnP (Plug and Play) and Power management using legitimate exports from ks.sys (e.g., KsDefaultDispatchPnp, KsPropertyHandler). The code implements standard device creation, property management (PropertySetReport, PropertyGetReport), and I/O request handling without any indicators of malicious activity, obfuscation, or unauthorized system modification.
